mainline: DNA and species identity feed the multi-scale U-Net/transformer backbone; 1D embeddings predict genomic tracks while pair embeddings predict contact maps.

components.label: DNA Input
components.visual_treatment: Short symbolic DNA nucleotide row and compact one-hot cells with 1 Mb and human/mouse labels. No biological artwork.
components.construction_provenance: Source-checked AlphaGenome textual architecture; native geometry plus inspected SVG grouping/input/frame constructions.
components.source_context: Nature Fig1a and Extended Data Fig1; Methods architecture

components.label: Multi-scale Backbone
components.visual_treatment: U-shaped convolutional encoder/decoder at selected scales 1 bp and 4 bp, with skipped intermediate scales shown by ellipses. Bottleneck Transformer Tower is 128 bp; do not show any further pooling below 128 bp. Two matched encoder-to-decoder skips. Output embedder receives restored 1-bp decoder features plus a separate 128-bp transformer tap. Pair representation branch from transformer bypasses decoder to 2D contact output.
components.construction_provenance: Source-checked AlphaGenome textual architecture; native geometry plus inspected SVG grouping/input/frame constructions.

components.label: Genomic Tracks
components.visual_treatment: All eight 1-bp readout types plus histone modification and TF binding at 128 bp; native schematic aligned profile lines with donor–acceptor splice arcs, no measured data.
